selection: First reserved short interval of each original final recording; largest reviewed frame-zero non-goalie box per team that does not touch an image boundary. Selection uses raw reference boxes only.
labels: Manual raw-context review only; visible boxes, known out-of-view/occlusion, or uncertain identity. No invented boxes through occlusion.
metrics: Matched visible observations; identity changes between adjacent one-second references of the same confidently followed player; lost observation breaks reported separately. Not exhaustive MOT ground truth, IDF1 or HOTA.
